cards.title: Why Tantrums Happen and How to Help
cards.body: You can't stop a tantrum on command, but you can help build the brain that learns to manage emotions. Here's the science of lending your calm and how to tell when meltdowns signal something more serious.

cards.title: Protect Family Care Before Crisis Hits
cards.body: Identifying emerging vulnerabilities in family care early can reduce the number of families reaching crisis point. Intervention before breakdown is key to supporting struggling households.

cards.title: Screen Time Isn't the Real Problem
cards.body: A pediatrician argues that loss of human connection poses the biggest threat to kids, not AI or screens themselves. The solution is spending more time talking openly with each other.

cards.title: Make Halloween Magic for Your Kids
cards.body: From Day of the Dead to Samhain, celebrating autumn is centuries old. Creating moments of magic and connection through holiday traditions enriches family life.

cards.title: Partner's Behaviour at Kids' Sports Events
cards.body: When a partner acts inappropriately at children's football matches, it's worth having a quiet conversation to understand what's driving the anger. Finding the root cause helps improve the family dynamic.

cards.title: How to Navigate Family Gatherings Wisely
cards.body: Family gatherings can resurface old roles, expectations, and patterns that affect your wellbeing. As holidays approach, preparing strategies helps you navigate them with more freedom and choice.

cards.title: School Holiday Arrangements Divide Parents
cards.body: Two-week half terms spark debate among parents struggling with childcare versus those seeking cheaper holidays. Flexible school schedules remain a contentious family planning issue.

cards.title: Understanding Estrangement and Father-Adult Child Bonds
cards.body: Fathers who struggle to accept their adult children's changing beliefs and values may inadvertently deepen emotional distance. Understanding how to support independence prevents lasting estrangement.
